description: Tests whether the residual-simplex target μ₄ = −4.591 is a physical four-body quantity, by converting it to MeV and comparing against the nuclear-physics literature bounds on the genuine four-nucleon content of ⁴He. In units of B(D) = 2.224566 MeV the target is −10.21 MeV, i.e. 36% of the ⁴He binding energy (28.296 MeV). Jurgenson–Navrátil–Furnstahl (PRL 103, 082501 / arXiv:0905.1873) measure the SRG-induced four-body force at λ=2 fm⁻¹ as 'about 50 keV net' (0.18%) and quote the N³LO long-range 4N estimate as 'of order a few hundred keV' (~1.1%); the QOU μ₄ exceeds these by ~34× and ~204× respectively. Decomposed with the corpus's own unbalanced [n]_q, μ₄ = s₄ − g₄ with s₄ = +3.7804 (+8.41 MeV) and g₄ = +8.3706 (+18.62 MeV), so the large negative value is the ρ_grad = [A]_q!/[2]_q! reference OVER-SUBTRACTING. Note s₄ alone is 30% of B(⁴He), also far too large for a 4N force — the inflation is in the C(A,k) simplex basis, which has no saturation mechanism and attributes all departure from pairwise additivity to high-body coefficients, not specifically in ρ_grad. Pionless EFT (Platter–Hammer–Meißner, arXiv:nucl-th/0409040) explains the empirical Tjon B(³H)↔B(⁴He) correlation by the ABSENCE of a four-nucleon force at leading order, so there is no independent four-body scale for μ₄ to measure. CONSEQUENCE: matching μ₄ is not equivalent to reproducing 4-body physics; GAP-8's flat operator hierarchy (|μ₄/μ₃| = 1.02 vs 9.75) is not by itself evidence against the operator, and the bean qou-pve2 question 'what supplies ~10× per-order growth' is chasing a basis artifact. Honest reformulation: test the operator against the Tjon correlation, which is convention-free. SCOPE-(a): this constrains the TARGET's physical interpretation; it does NOT show ρ_grad is wrong and does NOT show the block-trace operator is right. Corpus-grep before declaring: 'Tjon', 'four-nucleon force', '4N force' return ZERO hits across content/, docs/, computations/. No Δ_λ, no μ fitted, nothing wired.

references: [epelbaum2008] Epelbaum, Modern Theory of Nuclear Forces, arXiv:0811.1338
Tjon, PRC 20, 340 (1979) — paywalled/pre-arXiv, NOT needed: superseded for this argument by nucl-th/0409040 which states and explains the correlation
mu4_physical_plausibility.verdict: mu4 = -4.591 is not a physical four-body quantity (34x the N3LO 4N estimate, 36% of B(4He)); its size is the C(A,k) simplex basis and the rho_grad over-subtraction, so matching it is not equivalent to reproducing 4-body physics — scope-(a) on the TARGET, not on the operator
